newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends a shade up on covering.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends a shade up on covering.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended a shade higher on covering amid market uncertainty. Lack of fresh leads kept the market rangebound.. June futures drifted in nine ringgit range. Next resistance 1,250, support 1230.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Also followed the futures market which is waiting for SGS 1-25 exports. Interest remained selective.
June futures contract fluctuated in a very tight nine ringgit range for the greater part of the day and closed four ringgit higher at 1,249 ringgit ($505.05) a tonne.
Traders said June futures resistance is still pegged at 1,260 ringgit with support at the 1,230 level.
They said the downtrend is still intact.
"Prices have been moving in a range this morning. We are cautious and many people are concerned over the fundamental outlook," a trader said.
"Exports in February was not good and the market is worried about the amount this month. It could still be small," the trader said.
Talk of problems with a sunflower oil shipment to Pakistan also cautioned the market, traders said.

Among physicals, March (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,285 ringgit against bids of 1,280 after trading at 1,280 and 1,282.50. March (central) saw offers at 1,275 against bids of 1,267.50 and March (north) at 1,265 against 1,257.50.
Apr (south) was offered at 1,280 with bids at 1,277.50 with early transactions from 1,275 and 1,277.50 and Apr (central) at 1,275 against 1,265.
Among refined products, Apr RBD palm oil was offered at $545 a tonne FOB Malaysia, May $540, June at $537.50 and July/Aug/Sept at $535.

Apr RBD palm olein saw offers at $577.50, May at $572.50, Jun at $570 and July/Aug/Sept at 565. Apr was traded $570 and May at $570. Apr RBD palm stearin was offered at $440 and Apr/May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $307.50.
